source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives flag-power self-normalization and the independent chi-squared pivot; Theorem 3 leaves the mixed rank-two kernel direction, and Remark 4 says its constancy is equivalent to the unrestricted three-variable converse.
The paper studies generic identifiability in linear structural equation models and presents a graphical sufficient condition testable in polynomial time.

The paper treats optimization over homogeneous matrix cones and their automorphism structure; it does not establish self-normalization-induced invariant flags.
